# Installing Cyclone UI (Dark Dimmed) Docs

Generated by `@razorwind/docgen`.

## Files

- `docs/themes/index.mdx` — documentation index
- `docs/themes/tokens/` — per-group token pages
- `docs/themes/tokens.json` — flattened token manifest

## Setup

1. Wire generated MDX into your docs site (Storybook, Nextra, Docusaurus, etc.).

Example for Storybook:

```ts
// .storybook/main.ts
export default {
  stories: ["../docs/themes/**/*.mdx"]
};
```

2. Open `docs/themes/index.mdx` as the **Cyclone UI (Dark Dimmed)** entry point.

3. Re-run Razorwind generate when tokens or registry items change.

## Regenerate

Docs under `docs/themes/` are generated output — edit source tokens/components instead of hand-editing MDX.
